skills.name: brave_search
skills.description: Search the web using Brave Search API. Returns top results with titles, URLs, snippets, and optional AI-generated summaries. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable.

skills.name: check_website
skills.description: Fetch a URL and return its status code, response time, and page body content.

skills.name: count_words
skills.description: Count the number of words, characters, and sentences in a text.

skills.name: roll_dice
skills.description: Roll one or more dice and return the results. Specify the number of dice and sides.

skills.name: web_search
skills.description: Search the web using a local SearXNG instance. Returns top results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Configure categories, engines, and max results via environment variables.
